t: Collect the purses with gold and gems

Then the jinn created purses with gems and gold from thin air, and they were already stacked on the camels' backs.

But since they all ran away, the riches all went with them. And by the looks of that purse I see in the distance, the riches are now probably scattered around the city.

Please help us collect them. We will give them to the city committee, too. They might build a library or an art club for children!
Thank you! Oh, they are so heavy.

Finally, our main problem. This jinn kept asking if we had any enemies... Really, what enemies can we have besides laziness, ignorance, and idleness? But my friend suddenly says, "Second pioneer group are our enemies, and we want to beat them in the competition."

But the jinn is dense, he doesn't understand today's world. He created an illusive army. What do we need an army for? We let them all go.

But they wandered into the city and started terrorizing citizens. They are ancient and thick! Please deal with them: they are just illusions, not real warriors.
I await good news, though I understand the task is not easy.

Great, it should be quiet in the city now!

We heard you're looking for information on what happened at the construction site? I'm sorry I can't help you. They promised we'd go on an excursion to the site, but it never happened. None of the pioneers were at the site.
Find Marianna Lopatina in the city

Well... We've been unlucky so far. But I know someone who always gets to the truth.

I hear people saw Marianna Lopatina in the city. Yes, the famous treasure hunter.

Perhaps she'll help us learn something.
So, have you met with Marianna yet?
What a meeting! Didn't expect I'd see you here.
Listen to the stories of the locals

I'm here for the Nezeb's treasures that have been recently discovered. I'm sure you've heard of them.

There could be interesting trinkets among them. I'm worried the Landfill Warriors will get there first, so I want to set out as soon as possible. But first we must learn as much as possible about the treasures. The local residents can probably tell you something interesting.
How is the hunt for information going?
Great. It looks like we might actually find something valuable here.

I'll need equipment to further study the desert.

Mainly a supply of water, tools, and a camel.

I'll take care of the rest, you only need to get these.
Great, now we have almost everything we need.
Greetings, greetings! Are you going on a trip or just restocking? It's the best water in the city, I'll even give you a discount.
Help Marianna find the treasure map

Finally. The preparations are almost complete. We only need the map now.

And I even know where we can find it. But it will be difficult. It's in the rooms of the Tower. We won't be able to enter it directly.

But there's a secret passage in the copper mines under the city - it's where Zem slaves used to labor away. One Arisen historian told me about it. But alas, I don't know where this passage is.

That's where you come in. You'll cover my back, should anything happen.
I think I can squeeze through that gap Thank you for your help.

Ask Alice about her investigation among the pioneers.

It will probably take some time...

Fine, we've been through a lot together, so we're not exactly strangers. The issue with the Gates is clearly a serious one, and I see you have a good reason to suspect the pioneers.

I'll carry out my own investigation among the pioneers. I'll talk to my friends, too. If it's one of us, I promise

we'll find out.

But the pioneers are smarter than people give them credit for! We'll need to be sneaky...
We can't rush these things... We already did once!
I see... Well, if you trust her, let's give her some time. Since we have other matters to attend to...
Hello! How can I help you?

How could I be there? And what makes you think so? Look how many pioneers are in the city! And you think it was me of all people?

You say a Chronophone went missing? But the Gates can still be repaired? Phew, I was afraid they were completely broken... I wonder what could cause irreparable damage?

Don't look at me like that. Theoretically speaking, I mean. You know, I want to help you. I think... the pirates did it. Yes, astral pirates got here. They needed the Chronophone, and they can disguise themselves as any pioneer. And I'm just an exobiologist. Let's try and figure out who it could be.

You're asking me... No one knows! Well, they are the pioneers - they are quite inventive. We need to find out who stole the part, and it won't be easy to wriggle into everyone's favor. But I'm working on it!
h: How long is this investigation going to take?

t: Summon Skulnar the Fierce to Suslanger

Alright, you've managed to prove that you can make a difference!

Let's think about the ways you can help us... You see, we have been sitting here for a long time - ever since Kurgan predicted that the Legendary Orc would come out of the portal...

But he's not here. And Shrinka, that bastard, says we'll wait forever for him... My guys, the Merciless, believe me... But all the other clans are starting to have doubts. We can't wait forever!

One wise guy once said that "sometimes fate needs to be hurried along." I agree with that. It's time to give this fate a good kick. And send it flying. This red-haired chick, your Eladia, told me everything: the orc who wields magic is now undergoing some kind of training there... with the Elves. Pshaw! He will still have to prove that he is worthy of leading us.

But we don't have anyone else. So you need to bring that one here! Therefore: at sunset we go to the Portal... In the meantime, we'll wait here so you don't kill anyone else, hah.
Okay, the guys are properly inspired now... But they can quickly lose faith. You and your friend can chat later. There are many challenges ahead of you...
Oops, where am I... I was just training... It's you again, my friend! I'm glad to see you...

What does it matter now? What, you think it's something new for me? We went through so much together, I wouldn't even be surprised if you sent me to another planet! A desert is nothing...

Yes, and I know many things...
h: Skulnar! I hope we haven't disturbed you...

t: Reach the Legendary Orc's test site

We're not waiting. The sooner we're done with the trials - the easier it will be for everyone! And Shrinka's guys are already coming up here.

Go to this chief jinn... What was his name... Hassan ibn Khottab... That is... He's out there in the desert. You know him, and we do, too.

We will all meet there.
We'll start here. Khottab will help us, and we will help him. What, you really think we have lived near the jinns without knowing it?

Listen up, everyone! The prophecy says our people won't be poor, that the leader of the new Horde will give us gold and jewels!

Now listen, you two. For appearance's sake, you'll be our assistant or witness, but in reality, you'll be our leader's hand. We need to keep him safe. Kurgan and I know about your connection, don't worry. It would just take too long to explain it to the others.

As for the task... There are indeed hidden treasures in the sands and, in our estimation, they are indeed untold. But you will never find them yourself, no miracle can help here. And this jinn Hassan should help.

Talk to him and start looking.
There! Let the guys rejoice and pretend they are rich...
Find Nezeb's ancient artifact for Erfar

In the scrolls that we found, I read about some ancient and extremely interesting item hidden in these sands... It's one of Nezeb's artifacts.

It probably sounds boring to you, but I'm very interested. I would have gone myself, but I'm just a ghost, and the local magic doesn't recognize me for some reason, and this respectable jinn doesn't respect other people...

Will you help me? Then we're even! I will mark everything on the map and write it down in my diary. I don't know much - just the place where you can find ancient steles in the desert.

Ooh, give it here... The secret of immortality... Gray Prince...?

Ahem, it's just fairy tales! You go do your thing...
Escort the convoy to the landfill

Listen up, everyone!

The second statement of the prophecy is that the leader of the new Horde will solve our problems and protect us from troubles!

We'll see! If he can escort the convoy with treasures to our home, then he will continue to protect us!

...Anyway, you're on your own here. We didn't arm the guys on the cars on purpose. I don’t know who might attack you on the way, but someone will attack you for sure. At least it won't be the Orcs, hah!

They will meet you at the gates. Don't waste time.
Is the caravan on its way?
Great... I hope the riches won't be all gone by the time we come back.

Listen up, everyone!

The prophecy says our new leader will protect us from all enemies, even the most powerful of them! Is there anyone in the desert who is more evil and powerful than the Ifrits?! The revived Legendary Orc must be stronger than an Ifrit... No, two Ifrits! Three!!

...Now you listen. Anyway... Ifrits are now gathering at the edge of the desert, behind the mountain. It was Khottab who pointed out the place. He has an enemy there, so before you go, talk to him. He's earned that...

And as proof, bring... I don't even know... Whatever is left - bring me that!
Well, how is it going with the Ifrits?

There! Look, everyone! All that's left of the Ifrits! Our leader did it with just his eyes! But is he ready for the main challenge?!

I'd better throw this away before someone tries to eat it.
Defeat Fereshte Mazandarani, the queen of all the Ifrits.

Even the old Khottab has enemies in the desert. He asked us for a small favor, since you're going there anyway.

I even remembered it word for word. There's someone we need to kill. That's how he phrased it, "Fereshte Mazenderani, a creature that is repugnant to any jinn. She is as malicious as they come. While I'm trying to help as many people as I can, she just wants everyone to suffer. She is stronger than the others, and I can't get into her domain!"

He does have a way with words. Anyway, she lives behind the mountain at the edge of the allod, together with several of her... Girlfriends.

Drive her out of this world for a while at least - this way we can repay Khottab for everything he's done and will do for us. Report to him once you're done.
Have you fulfilled my request yet?
Good to know. There will be less evil in these deserts for a while...
Help Skulnar the Fierce defeat Uro-Boros

So! The time has come for the most important undertaking mentioned in the prophecy - to defeat the most powerful creature among the sands!

Is there anyone more powerful than the giant worm Uro-Boros? Even the bane of worms, the Hero of Sarnaut, almost died saving us from it!

Anyone who can defeat it deserves to be called the greatest warrior!

And I will say more - our future leader can control its mind! Soon we'll see it ourselves!

Our main task is to ensure that no one is eaten. , you will distract Uro-Boros while Skulnar takes over its mind. You will have to give it your best shot, but if everything goes according to plan, we will make it.

How do we find it? There is one place in the desert where no one lives, and for good reason...

We will prepare Skulnar and wait for you there, Hero of Sarnaut.
The last trial... Let's not waste any time.

Ugh… It's been a long time since I did this… Did you see how huge it was?

Wait... I think I sense something else...

I sense that someone got in trouble during this storm, !

Hardly anyone of the living remembers its purpose ... And even fewer would be able to read it.

I see three people: a pioneer in the middle of the river at the edge of the allod, a girl in the depths of the deserts with an injured leg, and a merchant on a rock surrounded by crocodiles!

Well, why are you looking at me like I'm a crystal ball? Keep walking!
That's great... Now we can all take a break!

! How did you get here? Ugh, I feel so much better now...

I, you see... Well... I'm stuck here in the middle of the river. I somehow got here during the storm, and now...

I'm afraid of lizards. I can't help myself.
I hope my little island won't be flooded...
Thank you, ... For everything. I'll catch my breath and get back to the investigation.

Oh, ! It's a good thing you decided to travel through here, I really thought I'd lose my leg...

They bit me while I was trying to get to a shelter through the Storm! You need to act quickly - collect the Snake Glands in the area, squeeze the poison out of them into my flask, and then I'll turn it into a cure for myself...

Hurry while I'm still awake.

Well, if it hadn't been for you, I would've been left in the sands with one leg! I owe you. I guess our paths will cross again. I saw everything I wanted on Suslanger and collected enough treasures. The road is calling now!
Help the merchant who got into trouble

Ooh, my old friend! It's so nice that you're here to help me!

You see, I was carrying some... heirlooms out of the desert. Then suddenly a storm hit, the caravan scattered, and I found myself on a rock, all alone!

I can run away from the local creatures, but I don't want to leave my possessions here... Pick up at least something, alright?

Well, I don’t know... Eight chests?

There they are, lying around the oasis. Right next to the crocodiles.
Ugh, it's hotter than in the city here!
It's so great there are heroes like you! I'll even give you a discount...! Maybe. A small one.

Well, while you were gone, I had a chat with Fury. She deigned to come down here to see me, hehe... So it wasn't all for nothing. It looks like I really am the leader of the Horde... I'm not even surprised. All this nonsense has nothing on that drinking bout at the Great Ball.

Fine, you go talk to Fury now. I'm tired of all these affairs and conversations. There'll be even more of them in the future...
Well... This is a success, I guess. The Orcs are now busy with the Orcs, and there's nothing to distract us. But... The investigation is still not finished.
Fine, inform Simon of our progress. I need to think things over...

I see! Well, it wasn't without bloodshed, but at least no civilians got hurt.

The Empire will know about your service to Suslanger, rest assured. In this difficult time, it's hard to find those who have enough strength and time to help ordinary people...
Resolve the conflict with the orcs

Hmm, it was a difficult time for us... Look, we don't have enough forces on this allod to be able to oppose the Orcs. But we can't wait either - time is on their side.

I think I prefer a bold attack - so our side will take the initiative.

You seem to know more about the current situation in their camps than anyone else. Let's discuss it and plan our next move.

There you have it. Hear that?! Don't touch them!

Your new red-haired girlfriend will stay with us, hah. We'll have a chat with her.

Now let's talk business...
Knock over the bowls with the Ambrosia and get rid of the Ambrosia Berserkers

It's this... Ambrosia!

The Unyielding have gathered a lot of it. Now they eat it for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. And it made them so fierce, it's terrifying. Tep knows what will happen to them later, maybe they'll grow a third arm or a second... ahem! Doesn’t matter.

I don't want my guys to become junkies, too. They would never be able to get off this crap. Kill all these stoned idiots and knock over their bowls so there's nothing left.
Their Ambrosia is soaking into the ground now, I hope?
Great... At least there'll be no more Ambrosia Berserkers.

Now that we have more problems here, every manamobile counts.

And you know how they like to break... You'd think we'd have lots of spare parts scattered around here at the Landfill, but not all of us are capable of finding the right ones.

Our engineer won't scavenge through garbage himself, and his assistants are even worse. And those... mechanics from the Izune trade school...

We sent them to look for the parts the other day, and they still haven't returned.

Go find out how they are doing and bring me parts, if possible.
So what's up with those blockheads?
Cool! It's such a small thing, what makes it better than any other pieces...? Fine, I'll tell the engineer when he comes back. He'll be happy, and that means we'll be happy, too.
Reduce the numbers of Ambrosia Hyenas

The Unyielding didn't want to attack us themselves, so they decided to play dirty.

Just imagine what they came up with - they feed the poor hyenas with Ambrosia until they become ferocious, then release them into our territory!

They form packs, and these packs are getting bigger and bigger. They started crawling out of every corner... We don't have time for these hyenas. And few are willing to risk their neck. There was one here... They latched onto his hand. And bit it off. He ran away from them. They attacked his leg! And chewed it off, too. Their teeth are like steel, they cut through rebar!

You'll have to... Scare them a bit. You don't need to kill all of them or drive them out of here. They are living creatures, and they protect the camp.

We'll just show them we're not afraid of them. They should know their place.
Well, did you scare the hyenas into hiding?
That's more like it! It's not really a problem, but there's... What was it... a defense line!
Find out what the Raiders are planning.

We are trapped on this allod, and now we all have one common problem - the orcs.

Of course, the Landfill Warriors behave themselves for the moment, waiting for the arrival of the Legendary Orc... Ha ha, they'll be waiting for a long time. Skulnar is on the Nea allod, taking courses from Zayan - "How to become a Great Mage in a year."

There are others with more radical views... They pose a serious threat. If they attack the city, I will kill them all sooner or later. But our precious scientists might end up as casualties, and I'd like to avoid that.

So, to understand what you need to do, talk to Simon. He will bring you up to speed.
Do we know what the Raiders are planning?
Hmm... He's not leaving us a choice. We'll have to take action.
Learn about plans for sabotage from George Bekin

We can't go to war against the Orcs - we don't have enough people. And we can't wait for them to attack either. We'll have to act wisely and learn the art of sabotage. I bet you've done this before.

 General Bekin is busy with reconnaissance - if there's anyone who knows how we can foil the Raiders' plans, it's him. It looks like you'll be under his command. Go see him.
Excellent! I have many tasks that need doing...
Reduce the number of Orc Raiders

As my grandfather used to say, you need to start with the basics! And the basis of any army are regular Orc Raiders!

First, they are demoralized by the very fact that they are being raided.

Second, the smaller the Raiders' numbers, the weaker the raids.

Third... Why am I even talking about this? I say the word "raid" way too often!

You know what to do? Go!

There's something... Well, it's about principles!

During their raids, the Orcs grab everything that's not nailed down. Food I understand, but they also steal personal items! They have nowhere to put them, so they must be lying around somewhere in their camp.

Bring back what you can - so the Raiders know how it feels when something is taken from them.
I wonder if it angered them further...
Any heat is bearable when you have a job to do!
Oh, they got me good... We shouldn't have provoked them...
Defeat the leader of the Orc Raiders.

...My grandmother said a fish rots from the head down. This has little to do with our issue, but still...

I think we should hit them harder! Ordinary soldiers dying is nothing for them. To stop preparations for the assault, you need to eliminate those who will lead this assault.

There are three of them. They are easy to spot.
Tell Simon about the orcs' plans.

Oh, how is my Lucretia? Will I ever see her? Or will I become food for vultures in this endless desert...? And the sky... It's such a beautiful sky...

Don't worry, I'm fine... Just a couple of broken ribs. They weren't going to kill me - they just wanted me to pass a message.

And the message is simple - soon we will answer for our insolence, and the whole city will burn in flames.

Report to Simon. Then you'll decide what to do. I don't think we can withstand their attack.

Ask someone to come get me. I still have water, but I won't be able to make the journey on my own.
What? I'll send after George. It looks like our actions only made the situation worse.

Hi!

You are probably waiting for this letter? Have you forgotten about our investigation on Suslanger with your heroic deeds?

Alas, I had some difficulties, so I don't have any good news for you. I need your help, so come by when you can. See you soon.
I'm glad to see you again!
Wait for the results of Alice's investigation

What can I say... We did well! The city is safe. Another problem solved.

You say your friend is still investigating it, and she's even making progress? Well, let's give her a little more time. We still have it... Besides, the world is changing anyway. This Ambrosia ... I don't know where it came from, but it looks like it's some kind of universal remedy for everything!

It heals and repairs; increases allods; powers engines... But there is only one "but"... It loses its properties over time. It won't last long. And since there is not enough of it, we can't let anyone in here yet, you understand?
You know what? There is a limit to my patience. I feel like I've been waiting for months, and there's still no news. We need to act!
Steal a car and escape the Landfill
We have the keys, the supplies are in the trunk... You can say goodbye to the locals, then we'll talk before we leave.
Come on, let's not waste time!
Phew... I'm never letting you drive again...
Just look at her. What a beauty!

Yes. The thing is, taking the main road would be suicide. The Orcs would intercept us.

We'll have to take... A slightly unusual route - it will also be suicide, but the chances of a happy outcome are much higher.

So before we start the engine, I need to know - do you trust me or not?
h: You wanted to discuss something before we leave?

t:
This will complicate things in the future... But you don't have a choice here.

See the frame of a ship over there? If I correctly estimate the power of this car, we'll have enough speed to drive over it and jump right into that huge stone arch... And the rest of the Orc manamobiles won't be able to do it.

Before they realize where they can catch us, we'll make it to the city... I hope. I'm not sure where we will end up...

Is everything clear?
h:
No, I don't.

[Alice will remember that]

t:
I'm glad to hear that. Trust is an important thing in the desert...

See the frame of a ship over there? If I correctly estimate the power of this car, we'll have enough speed to drive over it and jump right into that huge stone arch... And the rest of the Orc manamobiles won't be able to do it.

Before they realize where they can catch us, we'll make it to the city... I hope. I'm not sure where we will end up...

Is everything clear?
h:
Of course, I trust you.

[Alice will remember that]

t: Oh... I don't have much left either! Alright, take some, but use it sparingly!
h: Could you give me some water...?

t: You have a bag full of it! Absolutely not...
h: Could you give me some water...?

t: Eliminate the scorpions in the area

That was a hard landing... I'll need time to fix everything.

While I'm busy - could you keep the scorpions away from us? They are too strong here, and it makes them bold. I don't want to wait and see if they attack first.

It looks like they are coming from the Ambrosia oases nearby...
The proximity of these scorpions still bothers me...
Excellent. I'm glad I can count on you! Now don't distract me...
Collect enough Ambrosia Crystals in the area to power the car

...And I'm out of mana now, great! What a trip...

Oh, that's fine. Just collect a few Ambrosia Crystals for me, there should be plenty of them in the area - we'll use that. They are probably more power-efficient than mana anyway!

You can get crystals off the scorpions, too... If you're in the mood.
Deal with it quickly, I don't want to spend the night here...
Uh-huh, should be enough to get us to the city!
Find the chests with ancient scrolls in the sands

Listen, since you’re stuck here for the time being, mind returning the favor for when I helped you?

I looked around and found several ancient chests scattered not far from here - right near the oases! I'm really interested in the local scrolls... But a ghost like me is not very good at opening heavy chests.

If you help me, I could give you a hand next time...
We make fine archeologists! Thank you, now I have something to read in the evening...
Get to a safe place with Alice
I think we can continue our journey... But I'm driving this time!
I think I've had enough of adventures...
Drink some cold water to get rid of the effects of the heat.
Wow... I see you haven't had a drop in a while! That's not good. You won't be much use if you pass out... Freshen up first, then we'll talk.
That's more like it. We can talk business now...
Buy cold water from the jinn

Oh, Tep, all water bottles broke when we landed... Without it, we won't last long here.

See the jinn in the shelter over there? He probably has it... Not for free, though. I don’t know where they get it, but they are jinns - why should it surprise us?
You should hurry while we're still alive.
Great! Give me one... Now that we're not in danger of dying from a sunstroke, we can move on to other problems.
Find out how to avoid dying from the heat in the desert!
Well, first I need to tell you about the main danger in the desert - and no, it's not scorpions...
Excellent. It should last you at least a day!
Oh, a new recruit! I could always use an extra pair of hands...
Obtain 90 jinn relics from treasure chests during the Storm.

Oh, my young friend, the joy of my eyes! Allow the old man to request something of you. You've helped me a great deal already, please help me some more...

When the storm breaks, go to the desert to get the treasures. In those chests, you will find jinns' relics - they are what I need!

The greater your greed, the more relics will be revealed to you in the largest treasure by the end of the storm.

Ahalai Mahalai! Sim salabim! May the breath of the wind be with you!
I doubt you'll be able to finish my task during one Storm...
I see you have all the relics with you. Greetings, my young friend, the joy of my heart!

We continue to maintain the disguise! Today, like every other pioneer, you will need to provide daily assistance around Suslanger... Don't worry - since I'm the supervisor, I always pick the easiest task for my charges - collecting Ambrosia Crystals.

Find an oasis with the largest accumulation of Ambrosia, go there, survive the local wildlife, gather the crystals - and you're free for the day!

How do I know where the largest accumulation is? Ask around, someone has to know!
Make no delay. I know it's bothersome...
A true pioneer! I'm sure your friends are proud of you...
Go into the Storm and make the servants of Ifrits more powerful

Let's do what we came here to do - stop the heroes on the other side from advancing...

Alas, we can't challenge them directly, you understand.

At least Ifrits agreed to an alliance with me. It's not too hard - we empower their servants, and their servants fight heroes who want to get their hands on the treasures - trust me, almost all of them want to steal a thing or two from Ifrits.

We'll be rewarded! It's a win-win situation all around.

Keep in mind, Ifrits will only be appeased if the servant you empowered joins a fight against treasure hunters and dies - that's how the energy you transferred to it will return to them, and the servant will have done its duty. So try to empower them when they are already fighting or when you are certain they are about to start!

And the stronger the creature, the more power of Ifrits you can transfer to them! So don't waste your time on some fireflies.

You'll get your reward through me, of course.

Now go. I have things to do...
Great! I'm sure we just made someone's life more complicated... And every complication for them is an opportunity for us!
Eliminate creatures filled with Ifrit power during the Storm

I don't know where they come from, but especially strong servants of Ifrits appear during a Storm...

I'm afraid they are preparing for something, and we can't let that happen.

I will generously reward you for killing these creatures - don't worry, I see everything that happens in a Storm from here.
Have the servants of Ifrits been defeated?
Great! This week we were able to hold them off... But what happens next week?

Oh, my young friend, oil for my hair, comb for my beard!

I know the gifts you need to find, but only a small part of me will go with you to guide you. The sand will tell you where to look when you are there. But you will have to be thorough!

Are you ready to set out?

My dear young friend, fire of my life, juice of my apple! Your wish is music to my ears, like muezzin's call in the Old Town. Beware! Such power attracts unwanted attention! While you have this blessing on you, you will be attacked by jinns and defenders of the Court of Miracles!
h: Please, grant me the ability to see tracks on the sand.

t: Pit of my peaches, water of my river! You're asking the old jinn the right question! I do not know where the chronophone is. Even I can't know that. But finding the girl named Alice is in my power. I will give you the eyes of the wind, the eyes of the desert! You will see all that you need to see! Follow the footsteps of your friend. The first tracks are right here. She was visiting the old man, too. I wish I could have helped her.
h: Wise jinn, if you could kindly tell me where to find the girl Alice with the intricate device known as chronophone.

t:
Oh, my young friend! The extension of my fingers, the strength of my wrists!

Today is an unusual day for all jinns! On days like this, signified by the position of the true moon, sun, and stars, the jinns go on a pilgrimage to their ancient kingdom! They are reminiscing about the past...

On these days, the shelters are left without their guards. Of course, the evil Ifrits do not honor their traditions, which is why they will pose a threat to you and your companions.

Fortunately, you can find protection from their wrath in those treasures their minions are guarding! These gifts of the jinns will help you hide from the wrath of the wicked!
h: Tell me about the Exodus of Jinns

t:
Oh, my young friend! The strength of my back, the wellbeing of my belly!

To our people, you are all the same... Your squabbles are not our concern. We help all the inhabitants of the desert, because we sense that you will need treasures to fight the approaching darkness...

But as far as I understand, these orcs in the scrapyard were divided into two groups... One is called the Warriors, the others are the Raiders. Some obey the fierce warrior in black, the others revere the mighty warrior famous for his survival skills...

Jinns will help both!

Once these Raiders had no idea how to survive in the Storm... But they have learned a bit of wisdom - they know how to use shelters, and they know they need to look for chests. They are loading them onto their... cars. Of course, you could fight them for their chests before they take them to their camp... Otherwise, those treasures will be lost to you - they will belong to the Raiders.
h: The Landfill Raiders are roaming the desert now?

t:
My young friend, the joy of my heart! Allow me to tell you about the mysteries of this desert!

Great Nezeb, may his name be blessed, hid countless treasures in these sands. They have been hidden for centuries, but the Storm that came to these lands started uncovering ancient caches.

Every couple of hours, the wind grows stronger... First it reveals the smallest of Nezeb's chests, then large ones, and in the end, the Great Treasure - the biggest of them all!

But don't think they will be easy to get, my young friend! The treasures are protected by Ifrits' magic, and to open them, you will need the power of the creatures that guard them. With each opened treasure, your Greed grows, and the greater it is, the more treasures you will find in the last chest.

Be careful! During a Storm, it's easy to die and lose all the collected keys to treasures, along with a part of the accumulated Greed. Most of the dangers can be avoided, but beware of the Wrath of Ifrits - only my brothers can protect you from it in their shelters. If you don't make it to a shelter before the Wrath of Ifrits falls upon you, you will die!

Oh, my young friend, the joy of my heart!

I need your help again - I need an ancient artifact that would help me get rid of the Fire Ifrits and their ruler! It's an ancient copper lamp enchanted with Nezeb's spells! Its fragments are scattered all over the desert...

There are three ways to get them:

First method: the fragments in the sands will occasionally appear during strong magical disturbances, like the Wrath of Ifrits... But they appear shortly before it peaks!

Second method: other fragments were devoured by Uro-Boros - the only creature in the deserts whose stomach is strong enough for that! Defeat it, and you'll get the fragments!

Third method: some of the fragments were discovered by the Ifrits. They locked them in their chests... They guard those chests - and they are only visible during a Storm!

If you collect the fragments of the ancient lamp, I will reward you. You will receive the armor that contains the most formidable of my brethren - Devona.
h: There are rumors you're looking for lamp fragments...

t: I haven't seen these sands for centuries... Everything has changed.

Oh, my dear friend, the quartz of my sand, the breeze of my coast - you no longer need the essence of the Storm. You won't be able to get it from Nezeb's Treasure and you won't be able to use it to buy goods on Suslanger. But I'll gladly trade it for Ambrosia if you still have any left...

You have too much Ambrosia, my friend. I'm trading one Storm Essence for two hundred Ambrosia particles, and your purse is almost full and can't hold them.

Come back to me when you've spent some Ambrosia.

Yes, I wanted to talk to you.

Here our conversation will seem... Strange, considering you're the only who can hear or see me.

Let's meet on the northern side of the Tower, I'll be waiting for you behind the garbage containers.
There's so much to do and so little time.
Great! No one will pay you any mind here... Let's talk.

Yes, I wanted to talk to you.

Here our conversation will seem... Strange, considering you're the only who can hear or see me.

Let's meet behind the tower, I'll be waiting for you under the lantern.
There's so much to do and so little time.
Great! No one will pay you any mind here... Let's talk.
Collect enough coins to receive a special reward...

You see, I want all recruits to be sufficiently motivated to continue helping me.

So I reward them in a special way. For each task, I will give you a Pioneer Coin, so even if someone finds them on you, you won't be in trouble!

If you continue to complete my tasks during the week, you should accumulate enough to get your desired reward.

You think I'm stingy? I know you, heroes - as soon as you get what you want, you're off to save the world elsewhere, forgetting everything else...
Keep working to save the world... And earn rewards.
Great! It's not that I doubted you, but... Come back next week.
Look at that... They really knew how to build them back then! Everything works as it should!
What are you waiting for? Suslanger awaits!
Oh, we have a newbie here...
Oh, you...! Let me calibrate it properly, or I'll throw you into a volcano!

I'm going to smack you...!

...Yes, it's done! Go to the stele in the center, place your hand on it, and focus. I'll do the rest.
Find a way to escape the Orcs' camp
I don't know who you are and what you're looking for, but we're in the same boat right now. Let's think of a way to deal with it?
Are we getting down to work anytime soon?
Phew... That wasn't bad! Let's discuss our next steps?

Right... I'm sure.

No, we can't do that. These Orcs are not villains, and they do more good than harm... They just lack self-awareness. What kind of hero kills everyone who gets in their way?

...No, I think we can get out of here without any casualties. We must do it this way.
h: I'm the Hero of Sarnaut! I can handle a few Orcs!

t:
Wait until nightfall, of course!

...But there's another problem. Our cage is guarded by a really diligent Orc - you won't believe it, but he's actually vigilant day and night! He's standing aboard the ship right above me, see?

That's where I'll need your help. You'll distract him while I'll break the lock, and we'll get out... Then we'll improvise!
h: Hm... Fine, so what do we do?

t: Find supplies for a journey through the desert while staying out of sight

Alright, now we need to borrow a few things from the Orcs - we need them more than they do.

Just some food and spare parts... Why the parts? Because the Orcs' cars break all the time, and it's pretty hard to get hold of anything in the middle of the desert!

Just... Try not to kill them, alright? Since we managed to get out, we can grab some stuff quietly, too.
Go on now, pick it up...
Hey, come here, I'll pack it up... Here's water, we could use it!
Chase the hyenas away from Alice

I have another request... Did you see all the hyenas on the way here?

They are quite scary, and when it's dark, they get bold. And I'm all on my own here while you're away!

Could you please scare them away from me?
Defeat the parking lot guard and get the keys

It's time for the penultimate part of our plan.

As you can guess, we can't leave here on foot. So we'll take their best car - the one that will take us away from here.

The problem is, the parking lot guard has the keys, and I doubt he'll be willing to part with them. He's a tough guy - maybe you should find someone who can help...

But that's your problem. I'll sneak into the parking lot and wait for you there.
You have the keys? Excellent. There's only one thing left...
Knock over the bowls with Ambrosia

It's not easy to defeat the Unyielding. They are still strong! And the source of their strength is the Ambrosia they collect...

Therefore, we need to take this Ambrosia away from them! As I said, they collect it into huge bowls, then drink it. Go to their territory and knock over all the bowls, so they have to start anew!
Did you knock over the bowls with the Ambrosia?

That's great!

They should fight fair. And with this... stimulant, everyone can do it!

We shamans worship spirits and control the elements of this world... Rain, wind, lightning, nature...

But there is one element we don't like much, and there are reasons for that...

I'm talking about fire! Fire is wayward and dangerous... Those who serve and obey it are also dangerous... We are talking about Ifrits!

Fereshte Mazenderani, the leader of these creatures, has been interfering with my rituals... I know you've been asked to deal with her before, but she's about to rise from the flames again! Banish her so I can continue my work...
Good news. The spirits favor me today!

What makes Shrinka so tough? Not his size or his axe! The bigger the cupboard, the louder it falls, hah.

But his clan respects him. He's a hero to them! Undying... or is it immortal? Anyway, he almost never lost.

That's why he needs to be humiliated. Kill him so he can resurrect later. Then again and again! Then the Unyielding will understand that their heroes are not as great as they think!
I think this defeat will be a stain on his reputation!
Obtain 15 pieces of Desert Centipede Meat

You know we have little food here, right? It's a landfill, after all. Nothing grows here. You have to be creative to keep this crowd fed!

I heard the local desert centipedes have very tasty meat! Get it for me... so there is enough for everyone!
Did you get what I asked for?

Oh, great!

You will have a great dinner tonight, Landfill Warriors!
Obtain 15 pieces of River Crocodile Meat

There are creatures in this desert that are very meaty and delicious! They live near the river... No, what are you... what pioneers?

I'm talking about crocodiles, of course! But crocodiles have a lot of teeth, so it's not easy to get some...

That's why few bother to go after them... But you can do it, right?

Bring me crocodile meat!
Did you get what I asked for?

Excellent!

Everyone will be fed today!

The Unyielding continue to feed the Ambrosia to their damned hyenas... It makes them real ferocious...

I guess you'll have to reduce the number of hyenas again! We can't let these critters eat our fighters!
Did you kill the Ambrosia Hyenas?
The Unyielding with their hyenas caused me a lot of trouble. It's a good thing there are fewer of them now.
Obtain 15 pieces of Desert Hyena Meat

Hyenas are our faithful friends... But in times of famine there is no room for sentimentality!

I heard the numbers of desert hyenas have been rapidly growing... And we have nothing to eat here...

Well, before the hyenas eat the rest of the living creatures, we will have to eat the hyenas!
Did you get what I asked for?
I feel bad for the hyenas, but we need to eat something...
Collect 10 Desert Lizard Souls into the shamanic amulet

I want to perform one ritual... but I need souls for it... souls of Desert Lizards will work best...

I will give you an amulet - go where these lizards live, kill twelve of them, gather their souls into the amulet, then return to me.

Excellent!

At sunset I will perform the ritual and get the answers I need...

What? Are you still here? Go away, these are my secrets, you can't know about them!

Okay, you're helping me, so I'll tell you a secret: this is an ancient shamanic ritual of searching... Remember how you and I went looking for the Sting?

Now I want to find the girl who was with you, the redhead...

Not Eladia! Alice... There's something strange about her...
Obtain 15 pieces of Desert Rattlesnake Meat

Believe me, the desert is full of food, you just need to know how to get it...

Take the snakes, for example! They are poisonous... but if you fry them with garlic and onions, they are delicious!

Alas, our hunters are afraid to hunt snakes - what if we get bitten? Why don't you try? Bring me snake meat, and I'll be able to feed everyone.
Did you get what I asked for?
Great, it will be a little spicy, but that's what we need!

In our situation, it's important to be able to predict the future in time.

I foresaw the rebellion, that Skulnar will appear, and that the Ambrosia will flow into this world... Now I need to know what the Empire intends to do.

But it's not easy to predict the future: sometimes the signs are vague, the spirits are silent, and dreams... they can be completely ridiculous.

Then we're using means at hand. We can read feathers, for example. The Pridens love this, so let's follow their example. Bring me a few vulture feathers.
Well, how is it going with the feathers? Where are they?
Well, it's time to do a reading...
Kill any Ambrosia creature, collect its blood, then lure a sandworm on the Dry Soil, obtain its spike, and bring it to Fury the Merciless.

The most powerful creature on this allod is Uro-Boros, but it's not the only one. I know this vermin produces offspring, and they hide there, underground...

Sooner or later they will grow up and become like their daddy, but right now they are afraid to show their faces on the surface... You'll need blood to lure them out, but not just any blood. Only the blood of the creatures altered by the Ambrosia will do. For them, it's a delicacy they can't resist.

We don't have many weapons, and if we want freedom, we need more. Each of these creatures has a poisonous spike.

You will do this: you will collect blood, summon a worm on the Dry Soil, kill it, and bring me its poisonous spike.
Well, how is it going with the worms? Where are my spikes?
Great spikes, excellent poison. Should come in handy.
Collect 20 measures of juice from cacti in the desert

We still have enough food, but morale is very low. See how grim everyone is? What would help raise it?

Moonshine, of course! Silly people from the city have no idea that local cacti can be used to make excellent moonshine. A really strong one.

Alas, I just ran out of juice. You will have to go to the desert and get some juice there, then I'll let it ferment in the heat, and soon we'll have excellent fire water. Soon everyone will be merry again!

We have everything at our Landfill. They dumped all sorts of garbage here for almost a hundred years, so there is plenty to choose from, heh.

The only problem is that the parts may not last very long. But we can always replace them!

We need to fix our cars. Everything would be fine, but most of the necessary components are in the part of the Landfill where the Unyielding have settled.

Get us the parts, otherwise we won't be able to fix our manamobiles!
Excellent! Who are we without our iron horses? Just a weird bunch among piles of garbage.
Find out what the locals know.

Let's ask those who know this place better than anyone - the local residents. They are a friendly but proud bunch. First you will probably have to prove you're not completely useless...

You should start with the old-timers and activists. There are three of them:

Kasim Izetbekin knows everything that's happening inside the city. If anything strange took place, he'd know about it.

Jamila Kardaurina is more worried about the ways the outside world can affect the city.

Khasim Kehelin is a local inventor infamous for his unfortunate experiment with ambrosia. He's very interested in the scientists' experiments, so he could have been spying on them...
I hope to hear from you soon.
Is that all? The girl that got off the cable railway? That's not much... Alright, there's also one very nosy individual...
Find and punish the thieves from the Court of Miracles

There you are, dear guest! Eladia has told me everything. My interests are simple: help me, and we're even. We'll also check if you still have your wits about you after wandering around the desert for so long.

My friends have been harassed by the local brotherhood of thieves, damn their ancestors. We have no ways of fighting them. We have barely enough guards to keep our borders safe, and even if they could spare a man or two, they'd never figure out how to find these thieves...

But don't worry! My grandfather once found an artifact in the local sands. He said it "revealed everything that's hidden"! I don't need these things, but you'll probably find a use for it, yes?

Bring me ten daggers of these desert dogs - it will be enough.
How are the thieves? Do they understand now that you have to earn your living with honest work?

There! We are more useful than the local idlers called guards. They just collect taxes and nap in the shade. We can finally live in peace now.

I don't have any good news for you. I asked around, but no one told me anything useful. There are rumors of course. They saw a glow, and something went missing, but no one knows what happened.

I'm sorry. We won't forget your help - as soon as I hear something, I'll let you know.

Ah, there you are, dear guest! I was starting to worry...

I'll be happy to assist you with your investigation, but you'd better do the same for me!

While I'm asking around, can you deal with a problem at the nearest oasis?

It was a lovely place before the incident, beautiful and peaceful, save for an occasional Viper... But afterwards...

Let's just say the Vipers got bigger and more aggressive. We can't deal with them ourselves anymore, and they are trying to get inside the city walls! Could you... scare them off?
I hope the snakes won't be too mad at us...

Phew, thanks. We'll all be able to rest easy now.

I haven't learned much: at the time of the incident, there were just scientists and engineers at the site... No one from the city or the camp. So judge for yourself who is to blame...

There's something else, though. They say the trolley that goes from the mountains came twice that evening.

Ah, what? Ah, it's you... Hello!

I have a big problem - no one wants to help me now... One unfortunate experiment that no one even got hurt in - and the whole city turns their backs on you! And I could have supplied them with endless energy!

...Alright, alright. You are probably not interested.

Before, I would've just told you everything, but now I must ask a favor of you first. It's very simple, though!

I want to continue my research. I'll need the purest form of Ambrosia I can get - there's some in the nearest oasis. Alas, I can't go there myself because of the local Vipers. But you... you look impressive. I'll give you my invention - a special clipper that will chip off neat little pieces - you just need to squeeze it and focus...

Just don't use it on yourself!

Finally! I'm getting back to my research!

...Ah, yes. Information. So. The same day the incident happened, I saw a girl get off the cable railway that leads to the Gates. I can tell you for certain that she wasn't one of the scientists. I know them all!

Well... That's pretty much it.
Together with Skulnar the Fierce find Superintendent Dynin and join pioneers to find Alice and the chronophone.

There you are!

Let me try and explain it to you. Gates-3 are ready to open. We figured out most of the portals, too. The Storm will be over soon, and the Expedition has gathered enough forces. We found a way to transfer ambrosia to Umoir and Yakhch. That's where the main ambrosia tech site is. I caused a scandal, and Yasker agreed to give half of the resources mined here to Catherina. We're all allies, aren't we? As they say, it's peace on Earth and in people's souls.

You need a chronophone. I've already told you we can build one. It's going to take time, though. We're building a backup chronophone but it'll take us another... six months.

Do we even have them?

It seems that Nihaz has been dealt with. We've captured most of the Citadel. Hah. "Daddy" isn't a simpleton. I know him very well. He's plotting something. It's plain dangerous to keep delaying it.

Which brings us back to Alice.
So you want to be a pioneer, huh? Can do.
Ask Eugene Dynin about Alice and join the pioneer camp.

Ahoy there, folks!

That's my way of greeting pioneers and everyone who wants to join! Age doesn't matter as long as you're young in spirit.

We accept everyone, and I mean - everyone! I think it's only fair. Everyone must have a chance to work for the common good and hang out with fellow pioneers.

It only takes one simple formality to join: my approval, which you already have, and the approval of the leader of the troop you want to join. You will need to find her.

Do you have any questions? Shoot!
Being a pioneer is a hard but very big thing!
Greetings! Comrade Dynin has sent me a word about you.
Complete Nina Krasavina's quests by taking part in pioneer camp activities.

Good afternoon, comrades!

Happy to see you at the Dune camp. We're going to have great time together, I'm sure. If you want to know more about the organization, simply ask me.

You can also speak with any of my fellow pioneer leaders.

You must obey our routine, even though you're our guests of honor!

Before you can take the pioneer oath, you must do the following.

First of all, do the morning workout with us. No pain, no gain, get ready to train! A pioneer must start a day with a workout.

Second, take part in our lineup. It's important that you do. We do the headcounts and run through the order of the day.

Third, have breakfast. A substantial breakfast is a vital part of a well-rounded diet.

Come back to me when you're done.
All done? What?! Move it! Move it! Move it!

Great!

You have proved that you are good enough to be part of our community. Please raise your right hand to take the oath. Repeat after me. "On my honor I, , will do my best to do my duty to my world and to obey the Law of Nezeb; to help other people at all times; to keep myself physically strong, mentally awake, and morally straight."

And that's it. Welcome to the club! You're our kin now.

Skulnar can stay here, I have a duty for him. As for you, , I'll tell you what to do next.
Follow the coach's directions to workout.

What's the most important thing for a hero?

Good health. There's a healthy mind in a healthy body.

We hate lazybones and long sleepers. A true pioneer gets up at first light and works out! A couple of very simple exercises set the mood for the day and make your blood flow!

Our pioneer camp is honored by a visit of Boris Liev, a true master and a seasoned athlete! Do you even know how many times he was a Dionic Games champion?

Find him at the sports ground and do the workout, will you?
Hurry, there's no time to waste.

How do you feel about workouts?

I play sports, I even have a couple of trophies. And I hit the gym and workout every morning!
Follow the coach's directions to workout.

A true pioneer gets up at first light and works out! A couple of very simple exercises set the mood for the day and make your blood flow!

A daily workout is a must for a responsible pioneer. Do you want to prove yourself? Join the workout!
Hurry, there's no time to waste.

How do you feel about workouts?

Endure the pain!

Enjoy the gain!

If you can dream,

You can do it!

I LOVE workouts! I hope you'll come back tomorrow.
Complete the lineup without laughing. Respond to your name.

A pioneer lineup is just as important.

You want to be one of us, don't you? It means you must take part in our collective routine. We gather lineups whenever we want to kick off a project, sum something up, start a new day, or end one.

We begin with a roll call and then proceed to task distribution.

It's important that everyone listens carefully to the leader in complete silence. This will be your task for today. Keep order during the lineup.
What are you looking at? Join the lineup now!

I hope the team spirit is getting to you.

Pioneer, amazingly sheer,

One morning remarked to his peer:

A canner can can everything that he can

But a canner can't can a can, can he?

Trained skill in crafts and high intelligence. That's what separates pioneers from other organizations in Sarnaut!
No worries. It happens to the best of us.  Not the first disrupted lineup... not the last one, either.
Complete the lineup without laughing Respond to your name.

Pioneer lineup is a daily gathering.

We gather lineups whenever we want to kick off a project, sum something up, start a new day, or end one.

We begin with a roll call and then proceed to task distribution.

It's important that everyone listens carefully to the leader in complete silence. This will be your task for today. Keep order during the lineup.
What are you looking at? Join the lineup now!

I hope the team spirit is getting to you.

Only participation in pioneer events can win you the respect of your comrades!

Trained skill in crafts and high intelligence. That's what separates pioneers from other organizations in Sarnaut!
Get to the cafeteria, order a balanced meal, and eat it all.

We have a lot to do at the pioneer camp, so we need a lot of energy.

This is why breakfast is the most important meal of the day. We serve all types of food in our cafeteria. You're allowed to chose what you like the most.

Pick carefully, though. If you want to keep fit, you need to get the right balance of carbs, proteins, and fats.

Your task is to go to the cafeteria, pick three dishes, and have breakfast. Come back to me when you're done.
A real pioneer always finishes up food!

How do you like our cooking? The best in the Empire, am I right?

I must say, Comrade Dynin monitors pioneers' food very closely. There are weekly medical exams where they take pioneers' weight.

Nezeb forbid someone loses weight! It's a scandal!
Get to the cafeteria, order a balanced meal, and eat it all.

Have you had breakfast today? No? You should. We serve all types of food in our cafeteria. You're allowed to chose what you like the most.

Pick carefully, though. If you want to keep fit, you need to get the right balance of carbs, proteins, and fats.

Your task is to go to the cafeteria, pick three dishes, and have breakfast.
A real pioneer always finishes up food!

As you know, Comrade Dynin monitors pioneers' food very closely. There are weekly medical exams where they take pioneers' weight.

Nezeb forbid someone loses weight! It's a scandal!
You can't take out the food.

Main course:

 • Goat barbecue, Suslanger style.

 • Bacon crisps with sour cream.

 • Hashbrowns with green peas.

Soups:

 • Red borscht, meat broth.

 • Cheese soup.

 • Sorrel soup, vegetable broth.
Take the food to the orc announcer.

An investigation? What? What investigation?

Oh, right! The investigation.

Look, can we discuss it later? I've got some important stuff to finish.

Have you heard about the orc announcer? Yes, the one that recorded the war craft training material. He's famous.

They're starving him out now solely because he's an orc! Kicked him out of the ranks, too. He's sitting by the fountain all sad. I want to be supportive and let him know he's not alone.

I made sandwiches for him but the troop leaders are keeping an eye on me. Can you take them to him quickly, before they turn cold?

Wait a minute, have you eaten? Finish your meal first! Otherwise they won't let you out. We have this rule that you need to eat your meal before you can be excused.

Woah, food! I'll be damned! Thanks for remembering about me.

It's a nice feeling!
Were you too late? Did you drop it? No problem, I can make another.

Who? Ah, Sergey Russule! Let me think...

I know what to do! I got completely carried away with ethnography. Started gathering old folk tales, legends, and toasts. I had to ride a camel! There was no other transport.

And then I met her...

What was her name...

Lida... Zina... Oh, right. Nina. She's a local pioneer leader. We had such a lovely conversation.

She won't mind helping us. Tell her everything as it is, and ask her to help Russule. Give her my regards.
h: What is the real boy supposed to do?

t: Learn history of pioneer troops in the camp.

Do you want to know about our pioneer troops? To understand the nature of the Dune camp, pioneer friendship and principles of mutual help, you should understand the symbols.

All of them have decades of interesting history.

I can tell you everything. Just ask me.
Wait, you don't know about everyone yet.
Now you know everything. Aspire for number one, avoid number three.
Help the Dune camp prepare the festival.

Excellent! I know that you've already joined our ranks. As a good friend and a responsible comrade, you need to work for the sake of the pioneer camp!

Some Factory of Dreams actors have joined us here. Have you ever heard about the Illusion? Or the Motion Stories? It has become crazy popular over the last few years. Even the League admits that visual propaganda is effective!

They are going to show their latest masterpiece to the pioneers. It's festival time! And what are the most important things for any festival? That's right! Order and discipline.

Other troop leaders and I are working ourselves to death! You must help us maintain discipline and order.
Finally, everything is ready for the festival.
Find the SACK object and help Valentin Sliznin assemble the desorotype to record the movie.

Can you help me? Everyone around here seems to be busy. The director is again arguing with the screenwriter.

Huh? Of course, they're talking about the most important things. Like creativity standards and such. You must be thinking, "What creativity standards? Creativity means freedom, flight of imagination!" You're wrong. Even creativity must obey rules.

Sorry, I'm getting distracted. Here. This is a desorotype. The latest model, by the way. But there's a problem...

It's still to be assembled. The thing is, we're missing a very important part. The object called SACK. You know, the Sphere Action Camera Kit, SACK. It has "action" in the name because it's used to record the fastest and tiniest motions. It also a storage for everything that we're shooting. If we don't find it, we won't be able to store any of it.

I actually used it to store our latest movie. Can you help me find it? It looks like a blueish ball. I gave it to the pioneers to keep safe after we arrived. I shouldn't have done it... The premier night is just around the corner, and I lost the SACK! What if they mistook it for a ball and used it in a football match? Argh! It's going to be a disaster. I want you to ask around. Someone must have seen it.
So, have you found it? Oh, where is my sphere... My precious... I wasted so much time and energy on it...
Good work! Thank you! It could take me a whole day without you.
Collect Jungler antlers and red fern extract.

I would love to decorate the stage but I'm out of garlands. It's been a year since I restocked. Suslanger is far away from the Empire's main production lines.

We'll have to go with whatever we have. Tree branches will do. Or red dye of local plants.

The nearest grove is full of Junglers. They're a little dumb and shortsighted. They won't let you gather a twig... But I'm sure you can handle it! We can't give in to the nature, we must fight it.
All right, I'll pass your materials to our crafters!

As I said, we're out of garlands. At least, we have paper. It's been a year since away from the civilization. Suslanger is far away from the Empire's main production lines.

We'll have to go with whatever we have. We need more tree branches with leaves.

The nearest grove is full of Junglers. They're a little dumb and shortsighted. They won't let you gather a twig... But I'm sure you can handle it! We can't give in to the nature, we must fight it.
Great, it's enough to last us for a while. Junglers are going to grow, don't worry about them.

When I was a kid, I used to go to pioneer camps, too. It was a rough time. Even though they set camp at a hot distant allod, it was a wild area. The allod was called Chunga-Changa.
